Test connection
Connected (278 ms). Checking uses none of your answers.
Allow sending what I ask about to Inkling’s AI server. Your question and an image of what you selected go to Inkling’s AI server and are answered by Cloudflare Workers AI. Neither keeps your content: Cloudflare says it does not use it to train models or store it after answering, and Inkling’s server never stores or logs it. To share out the free daily allowance, the server counts answers per installation (a random ID this app made) and per internet connection, in scrambled form that is deleted every day. Don't include sensitive personal information. Cloudflare’s data policy
